name: What waits on Alcaz

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

summary: The aerial survey reveals a rune circle and several distinct groups on Alcaz.
description: The gryphon passes above Alcaz’s wet, broken ground. The survey sees a rune circle, black dragonflight, naga, hydras and human figures among the island’s marsh pools. These details establish a crowded and dangerous place, not an alliance between every group present. The scene’s aerial composition is an interpretive reconstruction based on the quest report; it does not claim that the investigator maps every camp or finds the prisoner.
